idea: ralph-orchestration copilot-exec --read-only revert guard (captureManifest in worktree-snapshot.mjs) byte-reads every file of each initialized submodule tree (codex/ multi-GB Rust + ai-developer-toolkit/) into a Map of Buffers; two concurrent Copilot read-only lenses exhaust memory (2026-06-06 member deaths). Fix the memory blowup while still reverting out-of-zone writes into the ai-developer-toolkit plugin-edit zone.

candidateDirections.name: Per-submodule git fast-path for nested repos (+ findNestedRepoRoots de-dup)
candidateDirections.summary: Treat each initialized submodule like the parent: use its own git ls-files/status fast-path, restore clean tracked files from HEAD/index, byte-capture only pre-existing dirty+untracked files; stop findNestedRepoRoots descending past a .git boundary. Kills clean-file byte blowup, keeps the out-of-zone guarantee.

candidateDirections.name: Protected-zone scoping — skip out-of-protection submodules (notably codex/) by policy
candidateDirections.summary: Snapshot only the declared plugin-edit zone (ai-developer-toolkit/) and treat codex/ as read-only-by-policy, pruning the multi-GB walk. Cheapest peak-memory win but hinges on the whole-cwd-vs-known-zones contract; devil's advocate red-flags skipping the wrong submodule as a regression.

candidateDirections.name: Hash/object-id detection + spill-to-disk for pre-run dirty bytes
candidateDirections.summary: Keep the whole-cwd contract but store hashes/object-ids in heap, restore clean files from git blobs, and persist pre-run dirty/untracked bytes outside the JS heap (spill or hash-object -w). All lenses warn hash-only is detection not restoration; adds crash-cleanup + index-fidelity complexity.

candidateDirections.name: Disposable read-only lens workspace (architectural reframe)
candidateDirections.summary: Run read-only lenses in a throwaway git worktree / sparse / COW copy with submodules uninitialized by default; discard the workspace instead of reverting the live tree. This brainstorm's own Copilot lens ran clean from an uninitialized-submodule worktree (live proof). Larger scope; lens may need submodule contents.

questionsForSynthesis: Contract: protect the WHOLE cwd, or only KNOWN high-risk edit zones? (sets the D-001/D-002 boundary)
Are gitignored files inside submodules in protection scope? (git status -uall won't see them; current captureManifest does)
Fix the 0-byte-output / exit-3 robustness sub-issue in this task, or split it out?
Restore-fidelity requirements for nested-repo dirty / partially-staged / renamed / mode-bit files
Layer a fail-closed resource budget (abort before child launch, distinct diagnostic) as defense-in-depth onto the chosen direction?
